conventions.transport: one bounded UTF-8 NDJSON stream multiplexes JSON-RPC and MHP 1.1 envelopes
conventions.initialize: legacy wide v1 offers select 1.0.0; offers bounded through mhp/1.2.0 opt into newest implemented minor; 1.0 receives only v1
conventions.versioning: breaking schema or semantic changes require a new protocol version and snapshot
conventions.edits: reject stale versions, dirty buffers and invalid/overlapping ranges before any side effect; apply atomically with one undo transaction
conventions.credentials: no secrets methods, password inputs, API keys or tokens; auth/github returns authentication status only
conventions.settings: validate values against package.json contributes.configuration before persistence
conventions.missingStorage: return value:null for an absent entry
conventions.paidConsent: runtime owns consent and ledger; UI returns opaque choice ids, never an approval grant

invariants: Panel frames require negotiated mhp/1.1.0. Validate shared payload and bound surface kind before delivery.
One immutable session binding per surface; unknown/closed surfaces produce typed errors and no delivery.
Sequence starts at 1 per surface and direction; reject duplicates and gaps without advancing.
Reload retains binding and sequence, suspends delivery until ready, then replays stateRequest once.
Closing drops queued messages; closed.droppedMessages counts them; warn MHP_PANEL_DROPPED when nonzero.
Cap UTF-8 serialized envelope bytes before JSON parsing, including unknown fields; exclude line terminator.
Bound aggregate queued bytes/messages; pause on write(false), resume on drain; overflow refuses before enqueue.

mappings.jcef: JBCefJSQuery; native receiver parses envelopes before dispatch
mappings.webView2: chrome.webview.postMessage; native WebMessageReceived validates before dispatch
mappings.swt: BrowserFunction; native receiver validates before dispatch
mappings.companion: POST /panel/message; POST /panel/surface; SSE /panel/events with event:mhp and JSON frame data

framing.results: methods[pendingMethod].result; correlate request id before dispatch
framing.logging: stdout is protocol only; stderr carries redacted technical diagnostics
